_comment: Story sections of the dashboard, in display order. Panels pick one via their `section` field. Maintained by the dashboard lead; titles and intros are placeholders for the science team to rewrite.

sections.title: The big picture
sections.intro: How much each forcing agent pushes the climate, and how that has changed since pre-industrial times.

sections.title: Greenhouse gases
sections.intro: Concentrations of long-lived greenhouse gases and the radiative forcing they produce.

sections.title: Volcanic forcing
sections.intro: Large eruptions inject aerosol into the stratosphere and cool the planet for a few years.

sections.title: Comparing methods and datasets
sections.intro: Where different formulas, datasets or CMIP versions agree, and where they don't.
